connector.name: Unblu
connector.registryDescription: Operate Unblu deployments: health checks, conversation ops, and 300+ API endpoints
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package unblu-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the detailobsessed account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UNBLU_USERNAME

env.description: Unblu password for basic auth (alternative to API key)
